# EmpowaYouth

> EmpowaYouth is South Africa's premier youth economic inclusion movement, connecting young South Africans aged 18 to 34 with accredited skills, direct employment opportunities, enterprise supplier development (ESD), and venture funding across all 9 provinces.

- Organization: EmpowaYouth
- Operating Under: EmpowaWorx Group
- Founder & Executive Producer: Simphiwe Masiza
- Motto: INSPIRED | CONNECTED | TRANSFORMED
- Official Website: https://empowayouth.co.za
- Contact: info@empowayouth.co.za

## Verified National Impact Metrics
- Youth Impacted / Reached: 294,000+ young South Africans mobilised
- Direct Verified Job Placements: 2,070+ placements with vetted employers
- Accredited Skills Certifications: 6,000+ sector-aligned qualifications delivered
- Township Enterprises Funded: 450+ youth-led ventures backed with seed capital & ESD integration
- Strategic Corporate & Brand Partners: 600+ partners across business, government, and civil society
- Geographic Footprint: Nationwide across all 9 Provinces of South Africa

## Flagship Activation: EmpowaYouth Week Vaal 2027
- Event Name: EmpowaYouth Week Vaal 2027
- Dates: Monday, 3 May 2027 – Friday, 7 May 2027
- Time: 08:00 – 15:00 Daily
- Location: Koinonia Bible Church, Sebokeng, Zone 14, Gauteng, South Africa
- Turnout: 10,000+ live youth delegates (2,000+ daily)
- Cost: 100% Free Delegate Pass
- 5 Dedicated Economic Sector Tracks:
  1. Day 1: Health, Wellness & The Care Economy
  2. Day 2: AI, Tech & the Digital Economy (4IR Workforce)
  3. Day 3: The Creative Economy & Film
  4. Day 4: Green Economy, Sustainability & AgriTech
  5. Day 5: Township Entrepreneurship & Innovation (Pitch Stages & Deal Room)
- Delegate Registration: https://empowayouth.co.za/vaal#participate
